description: Rank open tech jobs by how well they fit a person's skills, the way CareerHolo's resume match does: a match percentage for each job, the skills they have and miss, and which skill to learn next for more jobs. Takes skills only, not a name, email or resume text. Nothing sent is stored.

city.description: A city in that country, e.g. "Berlin"

country.description: Where the person works from, e.g. "Germany": jobs there and remote jobs open to it

roles.description: Kinds of job wanted; jobs next to them count too

visa_sponsorship.description: Only jobs that sponsor a visa

name: match_my_skills
title: Jobs that fit my skills
